patthana18.13:1.1: hetuñceva hetusampayuttañca hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetuceva na hetuvippayuttoca na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana18.13:2.1: hetusampayuttañceva nacahetuṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetuvippayuttoceva na nahetuca na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ. sappaccayaduka hetuduke nasappaccayaduka nahetudukaṃ sappaccayaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na appaccayo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ.
